id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint

interfaces.description: List of interfaces supported by the endpoint

ownerId.description: The ID of the owner of the endpoint

description.description: The description of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset.

model.description: The model of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset.

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the route as a human readable string or a localizable asset.

attributes.description: Device state attributes for this endpoint. Query responses populate this array when `GET /endpoints` is called with `expand=interfaces.attributes`; otherwise it remains the default shallow shape.
